technique_name: Analyze how the marketing strategy of a brand needs to adapt to the current situation.
description: In order to adapt their marketing strategy to the current pandemic situation, brands should focus on creating content that conveys empathy, hope and optimism. They should also emphasize their commitment to providing assistance and support to customers, especially those who may be affected by the crisis.
